comment: The TVs catalogue (Phase 12 M30, user 2026-10-28: "it should be a DB of TVs and I have two C1 and G2"). One row per TV model; an administrator ticks the models they watch on (setting tvModels), and a profile set to Best on My TVs prefers releases that every ticked model plays. A capability counts only when every ticked model has it. HDR10+ off means the set plays the HDR10 layer; trueHd off because the household has no eARC receiver (Q7). Phase 8's device catalogue grows from this file.
